newsitem.title: UK: AI(R) starts new marketing campaign.
newsitem.headline: AI(R) starts new marketing campaign.

text.p: European aircraft manufacturer Aero International (Regional) AI(R) said on Wednesday that it has started a second marketing campaign covering North America, Europe and Asia.

AN AI(R) statement said the objective of the campaign is to provide information on its development programme to the airline community. It said that the programme will be launched this year and the first AI(R) 70 aircraft delivered in 2001. AI(R) also announced that it has entered the pre-development phase for a new jet dedicated specifically to regional transportation in the 40 to 90 seat part of the market.
AI(R) is responsible for sales and marketing of aircraft of its joint owners, Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc and Italy's Alenia.
